g.title: CoPilot3
g.text: It's a systemic choreography of disappearance,
It’s not the opportunistic hand of a burglar—
it’s the cold,recursive logic of an apparatus.
The **iceberg quantum** is a brilliant metaphor:
what’s visible is trivial, almost dismissible.
But beneath it lies a submerged architecture
